title: 이 자식아
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie Pop with a laid-back, acoustic-driven arrangement. The track features a bright, percussive acoustic guitar strumming syncopated rhythms. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with occasional slides and light chorus effects. The bass guitar follows a melodic, walking pattern with a warm, rounded tone. Drums consist of a tight, dry snare and a soft kick drum maintaining a steady mid-tempo groove. Male vocals are delivered in a conversational, rhythmic style, transitioning into a smooth, melodic delivery in the chorus. The production is clean with minimal reverb, emphasizing the intimate, live-band feel. Key of G Major, 95 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[percussive acoustic guitar strumming]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals enter, rhythmic delivery]
전화 울려 모르는 번호인 줄
이름 떠 십 년 만이야 어이
모야 갑자기 어디서 튀어나와 [clean electric guitar fills]
포장마차 여덟 시
괜찮냐고 해
당연하지 뭐 바쁜 척 안 해
슬리퍼 끌고 나갔어 복장은 뭐
얼굴 보자마자 아 변했다

[Pre-Chorus]
[bass guitar becomes more melodic]
삼 초 만에 반말 야 이 자식아
소주잔 부딪혀 이유는 없어
그냥 부딪히는 거야 원래 그래
안주는 너무 기면 돼 우린 원래
거창한 건 필요 없었잖아

[Chorus]
[fuller arrangement, light percussion]
십 년이 뭐야
어제 본 것 같은데 [electric guitar slide]
